# 🎮 FORZA HORIZON 6 — MULTIPLAYER SETUP

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 1️⃣ Apply the Fix/Repair Patch
1. Extract `ForzaHorizon6_Fix_Repair_Steam_Generic_(1).zip`.
2. Open the extracted folder and copy its contents (**Ctrl+C**).
3. Paste (**Ctrl+V**) into your Forza Horizon 6 folder — **replace** files when prompted.
   -# Being asked to replace files means you did it right.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 2️⃣ Launch & Invite
1. Start **Steam** and keep it running in the background.
2. Inside the Forza Horizon 6 folder, launch the game via `forzahorizon6_loader.exe` (not the regular exe).
3. Create a lobby and invite friends.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## ⚠️ False Positive Notice
- **Online-Fix** lets you play with friends — grab the latest from **[ankergames.net](https://ankergames.net/game/forza-horizon-6)**.
- Make sure **Steam is running** before launching the game, or you may get an error.
- Extract the game into an **antivirus-excluded folder**, as recommended for OFME games.
- Any antivirus flag on `OnlineFix64.dll` is a **false positive** — safe to ignore.
- If you run into issues, **don't** download the OFME patch on top.
